story.title: Mark Zuckerberg attacks 'closed' AI rivals as Meta returns to open models

draft:
Mark Zuckerberg is taking aim at closed AI systems, favoring open models instead. 
I think this move by Meta reflects a broader shift in the industry. 
As AI becomes more pervasive, I believe transparency and collaboration will be key.
Will open AI models become the new standard?
